title: Turkey Gnomes
text: Turkey Gnomes. Gnomes have been extremely popular recently. There are some for every holiday and season. These turkey ones are fun! They are the perfect size for my tiered tray. The quality is decent. The only issue that I have had with them is that the turkey feathers come wrapped around the gnome body. I have been having to roll them the opposite way to try to get them to fan out properly. I'm not there yet, so I need to keep trying. If they don't straighten up, they have a tendency to wrap around the gnome again.

product_metadata.title: Thanksgiving Gnome Plush Decorations - 2 Pcs Mr and Mrs Turkey Gnomes Handmade Scandinavian Autumn Tomte - Fall Season Decor, Tiered Tray Decor, Thanksgiving Table Decoration, Housewarming Present

【Perfect Give Thanks Gift】 The Mr and Mrs Thanksgiving turkey gnomes are great for holiday gift to your friends, kids, coworkers. Bring good luck to family and is regarded as good luck.
【Holiday Gnomes for Home】Great to decorate for the holidays, suitable for your fireplace, dinner table centerpiece decor, tray, TV stand. Anyway, these little guys can add fun to Thanksgiving.
